notes.icons: Monochrome 16×16, stroke currentColor 1.3 — tint with svg(path).text_color(colour), like inkpaw icons.
notes.icons-neon: 20×20 lit versions in four colours for image(); the 2px border holds the glow.
notes.nineSlice: panel/frame/<colour>/{tl,t,tr,l,r,bl,b,br}.svg — 12×12; tile t/b/l/r, corners at the ends.
notes.tabs: tab-left + tab-mid × n + tab-right; overlay the -lit-<colour> pieces on the active tab; hang from tabs/wire.svg with tabs/clip.svg.
notes.pairs: Files ending -a/-b are two poses of one thing: cross-fade their opacity.
